name: Conditional Shipping and Payments for WooCommerce
author: Repon Hossain

sections.description:
Conditional Shipping and Payments for WooCommerce is a must-have plugin for WooCommerce store owners who want to take full control over their checkout process. By providing the ability to dynamically hide or show shipping and payment methods based on advanced conditions, this plugin ensures a smoother and more customized shopping experience for your customers.

Managing multiple shipping and payment options can often be overwhelming, both for store owners and customers. With Conditional Shipping for WooCommerce and Conditional Payments for WooCommerce, you can streamline your checkout page by presenting only the most relevant options based on customer-specific criteria.

Conditional Shipping and Payment Method is perfect for store owners who:

  • Operate in multiple regions and need to tailor shipping and payment options for each location.
  • Sell a variety of products with different shipping requirements or restrictions.
  • Want to reward specific customer roles, such as wholesale buyers, with custom shipping or payment methods.
  • Need to comply with tax, legal, or business-specific rules by restricting payment methods for certain product categories or locations.

What Can You Do with Conditional Shipping and Payment Method for WooCommerce Plugin?

  • Hide Shipping Methods Dynamically: Control which shipping methods appear based on cart contents, customer details, or date.
  • Restrict Payment Methods: Customize which payment options are available to customers based on their location, role, or order history.
  • Enhance User Experience: Provide a cleaner, more focused checkout process by showing customers only the options relevant to them.
  • Increase Sales and Reduce Cart Abandonment: By simplifying the checkout process and removing irrelevant options, customers are less likely to abandon their purchase.

Advanced Features of Conditional Shipping and Payment Method for WooCommerce Plugin:

  • Cart-Based Conditions: Create rules based on cart subtotal, weight, volume, or the quantity of products. For example, offer free shipping only if the cart total exceeds a specific amount.
  • Product-Specific Rules: Hide or show methods based on product category, tags, or shipping class. Ideal for stores selling diverse product ranges with varying shipping requirements.
  • Date-Based Restrictions: Enable or disable specific options during sales events, holidays, or custom time periods.
  • Location-Based Rules: Adjust shipping and payment methods based on the customer’s billing or shipping address, including country, state, and postal code.
  • Customer-Specific Rules: Offer exclusive options to specific customers or groups, such as VIPs or wholesale buyers.
  • Order History Conditions: Tailor options based on a customer’s previous orders. For instance, enable COD only for customers with a good track record.

Use Cases of Conditional Shipping and Payment Method plugin

  • Hide express shipping methods for bulky products or specific categories.
  • Disable payment methods like Cash on Delivery for high-value orders.
  • Offer free shipping only during promotional events or for certain regions.
  • Restrict specific payment methods for international customers.
  • Provide exclusive shipping or payment options for VIP customers or subscribers.
  • This plugin is highly flexible, easy to configure, and seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce. Whether you are running a small store or managing a large-scale e-commerce business, Conditional Shipping and Payments for WooCommerce is designed to meet your needs.

Why Choose Conditional Shipping and Payment Method for WooCommerce Plugin?

  • Highly Customizable: No matter how unique your store’s needs are, this plugin provides a solution.
  • User-Friendly Interface: The intuitive dashboard allows you to create and manage rules without technical expertise.
  • Optimized for Performance: Lightweight and built to run efficiently alongside your existing WooCommerce setup.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Extensions: Works smoothly with most popular WooCommerce extensions and payment gateways.

This plugin is your all-in-one solution for managing conditional shipping and payments, giving you the tools you need to create a seamless, professional, and customer-friendly checkout experience.

Support & Documentation

For any issues or questions, please reach out through the support forum.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin beginner-friendly?

Absolutely! The plugin features an intuitive settings page, making it easy for store owners to create and apply rules without any technical expertise.

Can I use this plugin with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes, the plugin is designed to be compatible with most WooCommerce extensions.

Can I disable a payment or shipping method for orders below a specific amount?

Absolutely! Set a condition for the minimum cart subtotal required for the payment or shipping option to appear.

How do I hide payment or shipping method for certain regions?

You can use the shipping or billing address condition to restrict for specific locations or countries.
